Convert a Greenlandic TA file between the two layouts

Source: R/ta.R
convert_ta.Rd

Reads a TA file in one layout and writes it in the other: version 1 to version 2, or version 2 to version 1.

Usage

convert_ta(path, out, to)

Arguments

path

Path to the TA file to convert. Its version is recognised, as in read_ta().

out

Path to write the converted file to. Must differ from path.

to

The version to convert to: 1 or 2.

Value

out, invisibly.

Details

This is read_ta() followed by write_ta(), with their checks:

  • 1 to 2: version 2 has no prim, afstm or fval. If any of them holds a value, a warning says how many rows lose it.

  • 2 to 1: the fields of version 1 are narrower (numbers 11 or 13 characters instead of 16 or 25, nrnr 5 instead of 6). A value that does not fit exactly is an error listing every such value, never truncated or rounded.

See also

read_ta() for both layouts.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
convert_ta("old.ta", "new.ta", to = 2)
convert_ta("new.ta", "old.ta", to = 1)
} # }
